comment: CEX product whitelist - which Coinbase products the engine may touch (typo/fat-finger protection, NOT anti-scam: Coinbase's listing process is the identity vetting on the exchange). The engine REFUSES any product not listed here - same law as the DEX registry. Add each product you actually intend to trade; the note field is yours (why you trade it, reminders). Ships with one example.
